description: FUNCTION SECONDS-PAST-MIDNIGHT (ISO 15.80) - the current local time as seconds past midnight in standard numeric time form (type NUMERIC, fractional seconds; documented 100 ns precision, scale 7, Annex A.1 item 171) on the injectable RunUnit.Clock seam. A 2014 INTRODUCTION, not 2002: the WG4 CD 1.2 (2009) Annex D.2 item 4 lists it among 'the intrinsic functions ... introduced in this committee draft International Standard' (kb/Work R28, decided 2026-08-08 from the archived primary document). Split out of the date-to-yyyymmdd-2002 row, whose other three functions are genuinely 2002.
citation: ISO §2023:15.80 SECONDS-PAST-MIDNIGHT; 2014 introduction per the WG4 CD 1.2 Annex D.2 item 4 new-function list; §2023:15.80.3 r3 documented precision 100 ns (A.1 item 171)
vcr: kb/Work R28 (2026-08-08): 2014 per the WG4 CD 1.2 Annex D.2 new-function list; previously mis-bundled with the 2002 windowing trio.
